title: Ear sensation logged on blog before the Indian Ocean earthquake

tellings.quote: So that was in September of 03, I believe it was.

plain: A former sergeant named Dan Sherman says he felt strange sensations in his ear and wrote them down on his blog before major earthquakes, once around September 2003 in connection with Japan and again before the great Indian Ocean earthquake near Indonesia. He tells it first-hand, pointing to his blog and to a 2006 update of his book Above Black as the record. Sherman, who says the NSA, a US intelligence agency, hired him to communicate with aliens, offers it as a sign that the sensations gave real warnings.
